title: Prioritizing global equity in migration research
core_idea: Using Scopus bibliometric data from 1996 to 2022, compile a comprehensive corpus of over 125,000 migration-related publications across disciplines to analyze content, identify gaps and missed opportunities, and examine demographic over- and under-representation of countries in global migration knowledge production.
tldr: Large-scale bibliometric analysis of migration scholarship (Scopus, 1996–2022; >125,000 publications) to map gaps and country-level representation and to prioritize equity in migration research.
